phenomena.description: 城市中不同年龄组可能因接触机会、健康状态和社会活动方式差异，呈现不同的感染发生率与增长轨迹；这种分化可能随疫情阶段和防控措施变化而改变。

phenomena.name: 环境特异性聚集持续
phenomena.description: 学校、工作场所和社区活动环境可能形成传播特征不同的感染聚集；某些环境中的聚集可能较家庭接触更短暂或更持久，并影响城市感染事件的时间分布。

phenomena.name: 家庭续发感染集中
phenomena.description: 家庭成员之间持续日常接触可能使家庭成为感染传播的集中场所；由指示病例引发的家庭内续发感染比例可能在不同家庭结构和活动模式下出现差异。

phenomena.name: 隐匿传播遮蔽
phenomena.description: 部分感染者在症状出现前、症状轻微或未被识别时仍保持社会接触，可能造成不依赖于显性症状检测的传播，使观测到的病例变化低估实际感染活动。

phenomena.name: 追踪能力饱和
phenomena.description: 当感染人数增长超过公共卫生部门识别和追踪密切接触者的能力时，追踪覆盖率和隔离及时性可能下降，进而改变后续传播链的阻断效果。

phenomena.name: 依从性异质反馈
phenomena.description: 居民对减少活动、隔离或检测建议的遵守程度存在差异；这种异质性可能削弱防控措施的实际效果，并随疫情感知和措施执行范围变化而形成反馈。

nodes.name: Agent new-exposure transition indicator
nodes.description: Binary per-agent, per-step indicator that an agent moves from not-exposed to exposed between two consecutively observed sampled steps of the same run.
nodes.mathematical_definition: X_i(t) = 1 if exposed_i(t) = true and exposed_i(t-1) = false, otherwise 0; defined only when agent i is observed at both step t and the immediately preceding observed step t-1 in the same run; undefined if either observation is missing.
nodes.computation_notes: Group agent_states by (run_id, agent_id) ordered by step; take the boolean exposed column at consecutive observed steps. Do not interpolate gaps: a missing previous step makes X undefined, not zero. Model-level rows (agent_id null) are excluded.

def compute_indicator(data, config):
    import numpy as np
    import pandas as pd

    states = data["agent_states"]
    base = states.loc[states["agent_id"].notna() & states["step"].notna(),
                      ["step", "agent_id", "exposed"]].copy()
    base["step"] = base["step"].astype("int64")
    base["agent_id"] = base["agent_id"].astype("int64")
    base = base.drop_duplicates(subset=["step", "agent_id"], keep="last")
    base = base.sort_values(["agent_id", "step"], kind="mergesort").reset_index(drop=True)

    grp = base.groupby("agent_id", sort=False)
    prev_exposed = grp["exposed"].shift(1)
    prev_step = grp["step"].shift(1)
    consecutive = prev_step.notna() & (prev_step == base["step"] - 1)

    cur_b = base["exposed"].astype("boolean").fillna(False).astype(bool)
    prev_b = prev_exposed.astype("boolean").fillna(False).astype(bool)
    usable = base["exposed"].notna() & prev_exposed.notna() & consecutive
    flag = pd.Series(np.where(usable.to_numpy(),
                              np.where((cur_b & ~prev_b).to_numpy(), 1.0, 0.0),
                              np.nan),
                     index=base.index)

    out = pd.DataFrame({"step": base["step"],
                        "agent_id": base["agent_id"],
                        "value": flag})
    out = out.loc[out["value"].notna()]
    res = out.set_index(["step", "agent_id"])["value"].sort_index()
    res.index = res.index.set_names(["step", "agent_id"])
    res.name = "p1_micro_new_exposure_flag"
    return res

nodes.description: Per-agent indicator that the agent has shown at least one observed new-exposure transition up to and including step t.
nodes.mathematical_definition: E_i(t) = max over observed steps s <= t in the same run of X_i(s), where X is the new-exposure transition indicator; E_i(t) = 1 if any such s has X_i(s) = 1, else 0; undefined if agent i is not observed at step t.

nodes.description: Rate of new observed exposure transitions in an age band normalised by the susceptible person-steps accumulated by that band at the previous observed step.

    import numpy as np
    import pandas as pd

    states = data["agent_states"]
    cols = ["step", "agent_id", "age", "exposed", "susceptible"]
    base = states.loc[states["agent_id"].notna() & states["step"].notna(), cols].copy()
    base["step"] = base["step"].astype("int64")
    base["agent_id"] = base["agent_id"].astype("int64")
    base = base.drop_duplicates(subset=["step", "agent_id"], keep="last")
    base = base.sort_values(["agent_id", "step"], kind="mergesort").reset_index(drop=True)

    grp = base.groupby("agent_id", sort=False)
    prev_exposed = grp["exposed"].shift(1)
    prev_susc = grp["susceptible"].shift(1)
    prev_step = grp["step"].shift(1)
    consecutive = prev_step.notna() & (prev_step == base["step"] - 1)

    cur_b = base["exposed"].astype("boolean").fillna(False).astype(bool)
    prev_b = prev_exposed.astype("boolean").fillna(False).astype(bool)
    usable = base["exposed"].notna() & prev_exposed.notna() & consecutive
    x = pd.Series(np.where(usable.to_numpy(),
                           np.where((cur_b & ~prev_b).to_numpy(), 1.0, 0.0),
                           np.nan),
                  index=base.index)

    susc_b = prev_susc.astype("boolean").fillna(False).astype(bool)
    susc_ok = base["susceptible"].notna() & prev_susc.notna() & consecutive
    s_prev = pd.Series(np.where(susc_ok.to_numpy(),
                                susc_b.to_numpy().astype("float64"),
                                np.nan),
                       index=base.index)

    age_vals = base.loc[base["age"].notna(), "age"].astype("float64")
    if age_vals.empty:
        raise ValueError("no observed age values: age bands are undefined for this run")
    edges = np.unique(np.quantile(age_vals.to_numpy(dtype="float64"), np.linspace(0.1, 0.9, 9)))
    agent_age = base.loc[base["age"].notna()].groupby("agent_id")["age"].first().astype("float64")

    def band_of(v):
        if v is None:
            return None
        fv = float(v)
        if np.isnan(fv):
            return None
        return int(np.searchsorted(edges, fv, side="right"))

    band_map = agent_age.map(band_of)

    work = pd.DataFrame({"step": base["step"],
                         "band": base["agent_id"].map(band_map),
                         "x": x,
                         "s_prev": s_prev})
    work = work.loc[work["band"].notna()].copy()
    work["band"] = work["band"].astype("int64")

    num = work.groupby(["step", "band"])["x"].sum(min_count=1)
    den = work.groupby(["step", "band"])["s_prev"].sum(min_count=1)
    table = pd.concat([num.rename("num"), den.rename("den")], axis=1, join="inner")
    table = table.dropna()
    table = table.loc[table["den"].to_numpy() > 0]
    res = (table["num"] / table["den"]).sort_index()
    res.index = res.index.set_names(["step", "band"])
    res.name = "p1_meso_band_exposure_hazard"
    return res

    cur_b = base["exposed"].astype("boolean").fillna(False).astype(bool)
    prev_b = prev_exposed.astype("boolean").fillna(False).astype(bool)
    usable = base["exposed"].notna() & prev_exposed.notna() & consecutive
    x = pd.Series(np.where(usable.to_numpy(),
                           np.where((cur_b & ~prev_b).to_numpy(), 1.0, 0.0),
                           np.nan),
                  index=base.index)

    susc_b = prev_susc.astype("boolean").fillna(False).astype(bool)
    susc_ok = base["susceptible"].notna() & prev_susc.notna() & consecutive
    s_prev = pd.Series(np.where(susc_ok.to_numpy(),
                                susc_b.to_numpy().astype("float64"),
                                np.nan),
                       index=base.index)

    age_vals = base.loc[base["age"].notna(), "age"].astype("float64")
    if age_vals.empty:
        return pd.Series(dtype="float64", index=pd.Index([], name="step"), name="p1_macro_band_composition_mismatch")
    edges = np.unique(np.quantile(age_vals.to_numpy(dtype="float64"), np.linspace(0.1, 0.9, 9)))
    agent_age = base.loc[base["age"].notna()].groupby("agent_id")["age"].first().astype("float64")

    def band_of(v):
        if v is None:
            return None
        fv = float(v)
        if np.isnan(fv):
            return None
        return int(np.searchsorted(edges, fv, side="right"))

    band_map = agent_age.map(band_of)
    work = pd.DataFrame({"step": base["step"],
                         "band": base["agent_id"].map(band_map),
                         "x": x,
                         "s_prev": s_prev})
    work = work.loc[work["band"].notna()].copy()
    work["band"] = work["band"].astype("int64")

    num = work.groupby(["step", "band"])["x"].sum(min_count=1)
    den = work.groupby(["step", "band"])["s_prev"].sum(min_count=1)
    table = pd.concat([num.rename("nx"), den.rename("ns")], axis=1, join="inner")
    table = table.loc[table["ns"].notna()].reset_index()
    if table.empty:
        return pd.Series(dtype="float64", index=pd.Index([], name="step"), name="p1_macro_band_composition_mismatch")
    table["nx"] = table["nx"].fillna(0.0)

    grp_step = table.groupby("step")
    tot_x = grp_step["nx"].transform("sum")
    tot_s = grp_step["ns"].transform("sum")
    keep = (tot_x > 0) & (tot_s > 0)
    kept = table.loc[keep].copy()
    if kept.empty:
        return pd.Series(dtype="float64", index=pd.Index([], name="step"), name="p1_macro_band_composition_mismatch")
    kept_tot_x = kept.groupby("step")["nx"].transform("sum")
    kept_tot_s = kept.groupby("step")["ns"].transform("sum")
    kept["e_share"] = kept["nx"] / kept_tot_x
    kept["s_share"] = kept["ns"] / kept_tot_s
    kept["gap"] = (kept["e_share"] - kept["s_share"]).abs()
    res = 0.5 * kept.groupby("step")["gap"].sum()
    res.index.name = "step"
    res.name = "p1_macro_band_composition_mismatch"
    return res.sort_index()

    results = []
    for step in observed_steps:
        group = step_layer_counts[step_layer_counts['step'] == step]
        if group.empty:
            continue
        counts = group['count'].values
        total = counts.sum()
        if total == 0:
            continue
        p = counts / total
        n = len(counts[counts > 0])
        if n < 2:
            continue
        H = -np.sum(p * np.log(p)) / np.log(n)
        results.append({'step': step, 'value': H})

def compute_indicator(data, config):

    df["diag"] = diag
    prev = df.groupby(["run_id", "agent_id"])["diag"].shift(1)
    had_prev = prev.notna()
    prev_bool = prev.fillna(False).astype(bool)
    isnew = had_prev & df["diag"] & (~prev_bool)
    lag = df["date_diagnosed"] - df["date_symptomatic"]
    valid = isnew & df["date_symptomatic"].notna() & df["date_diagnosed"].notna()

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd


def compute_indicator(data, config):
    states = data["agent_states"][["run_id", "agent_id", "step", "known_contact"]].copy()
    states = states.sort_values(["run_id", "agent_id", "step"], kind="mergesort")
    kc = states["known_contact"].fillna(False).astype(bool)
    states["kc"] = kc
    prev = states.groupby(["run_id", "agent_id"])["kc"].shift(1)
    had_prev = prev.notna()
    prev_bool = prev.fillna(False).astype(bool)
    isnew = had_prev & states["kc"] & (~prev_bool)
    trans = states.loc[isnew, ["run_id", "agent_id", "step"]].copy()

    ev = data["events"][["run_id", "agent_id", "step", "state", "after", "before", "layer"]].copy()
    aft = ev["after"].fillna(False).astype(bool)
    bef = ev["before"].fillna(False).astype(bool)
    ev = ev.loc[aft & (~bef), ["run_id", "agent_id", "step", "state", "layer"]].copy()
    if ev["state"].notna().any():
        m = ev["state"].astype(str).str.contains("known_contact", case=False, na=False)
        if m.any():
            ev = ev.loc[m, :].copy()
    ev = ev[["run_id", "agent_id", "step", "layer"]].drop_duplicates(["run_id", "agent_id", "step"])

    merged = trans.merge(ev, on=["run_id", "agent_id", "step"], how="left")
    merged_layer = merged.dropna(subset=["layer"]).copy()
    num = merged_layer.groupby(["run_id", "step", "layer"]).size().rename("num")

    contacts = data["contacts"][["run_id", "agent_id", "partner_id", "layer", "step"]].copy()
    contacts = contacts.dropna(subset=["agent_id", "partner_id", "layer"]).copy()
    a = contacts["agent_id"].to_numpy(dtype="int64")
    b = contacts["partner_id"].to_numpy(dtype="int64")
    contacts["lo"] = np.minimum(a, b)
    contacts["hi"] = np.maximum(a, b)
    edges = contacts.drop_duplicates(["run_id", "step", "layer", "lo", "hi"])
    edge_count = edges.groupby(["run_id", "step", "layer"]).size().rename("N")

    combined = pd.concat([edge_count.astype(float), num.astype(float)], axis=1)
    combined["num"] = combined["num"].fillna(0.0)
    den = combined["N"]
    keep = den > 0
    rate = (combined.loc[keep, "num"] / den.loc[keep]).astype(float)
    rate.name = "known_contact_rate"
    return rate

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd


def _undirected_edges(contacts):
    c = contacts[['run_id', 'step', 'layer', 'agent_id', 'partner_id']]
    c = c.dropna(subset=['run_id', 'step', 'layer', 'agent_id', 'partner_id'])
    a = c['agent_id'].to_numpy(dtype='int64')
    b = c['partner_id'].to_numpy(dtype='int64')
    e = pd.DataFrame({
        'run_id': c['run_id'].to_numpy(),
        'step': c['step'].to_numpy(dtype='int64'),
        'layer': c['layer'].to_numpy(),
        'u': np.minimum(a, b),
        'v': np.maximum(a, b),
    })
    return e.drop_duplicates(subset=['run_id', 'step', 'layer', 'u', 'v'])


def _layer_degrees(edges):
    left = edges[['run_id', 'step', 'layer', 'u']].rename(columns={'u': 'agent_id'})
    right = edges[['run_id', 'step', 'layer', 'v']].rename(columns={'v': 'agent_id'})
    stacked = pd.concat([left, right], ignore_index=True)
    d = stacked.groupby(['run_id', 'step', 'layer', 'agent_id']).size().rename('degree')
    return d.reset_index()


def _newly_quarantined(states):
    s = states[['run_id', 'agent_id', 'step', 'quarantined']]

    hi = np.maximum(c['agent_id'].to_numpy(), c['partner_id'].to_numpy())
    pairs = pd.DataFrame({'run_id': c['run_id'].to_numpy(), 'step': c['step'].to_numpy(), 'lo': lo, 'hi': hi})

    left = pairs[['run_id', 'step', 'lo']].rename(columns={'lo': 'agent_id'})
    right = pairs[['run_id', 'step', 'hi']].rename(columns={'hi': 'agent_id'})

    merged['degree'] = merged['degree'].fillna(0.0)
    rows = []
    for (rid, st), g in merged.groupby(['run_id', 'step'], sort=True):
        qd = g.loc[g['quarantined'], 'degree'].to_numpy(dtype='float64')
        nd = g.loc[~g['quarantined'], 'degree'].to_numpy(dtype='float64')
        if qd.size == 0 or nd.size == 0:
            continue
        den = float(nd.mean())
        if den == 0.0:
            continue
        rows.append((int(st), rid, float(qd.mean()) / den))
    if not rows:
        return _empty(['step', 'run_id'], 'suppression_ratio')
    res = pd.DataFrame(rows, columns=['step', 'run_id', 'value'])
    out = res.set_index(['step', 'run_id'])['value'].sort_index()
    out.name = 'suppression_ratio'
    return out

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd


def _empty_frame(col):
    idx = pd.MultiIndex.from_arrays([[] for _ in range(3)], names=['step', 'run_id', 'agent_id'])
    return pd.DataFrame({col: pd.Series(dtype='float64', index=idx)})


def compute_indicator(data, config):
    ast = data['agent_states']
    d = ast[['run_id', 'agent_id', 'step', 'date_exposed', 'date_diagnosed']].copy()
    d = d.dropna(subset=['run_id', 'agent_id', 'step'])
    if d.empty:
        return _empty_frame('exposure_to_diagnosis_interval')
    d['agent_id'] = d['agent_id'].astype('int64')
    d['step'] = d['step'].astype('int64')
    d = d.sort_values(['run_id', 'agent_id', 'step'])
    exp_rows = d.dropna(subset=['date_exposed'])
    dia_rows = d.dropna(subset=['date_diagnosed'])
    if exp_rows.empty or dia_rows.empty:
        return _empty_frame('exposure_to_diagnosis_interval')
    exp_first = exp_rows.groupby(['run_id', 'agent_id'], sort=True).agg(
        step_exposed=('step', 'min'), date_exposed=('date_exposed', 'first'))
    dia_first = dia_rows.groupby(['run_id', 'agent_id'], sort=True).agg(
        step_diagnosed=('step', 'min'), date_diagnosed=('date_diagnosed', 'first'))
    joined = exp_first.join(dia_first, how='inner').reset_index()
    if joined.empty:
        return _empty_frame('exposure_to_diagnosis_interval')
    step_out = np.maximum(joined['step_exposed'].to_numpy(dtype='int64'), joined['step_diagnosed'].to_numpy(dtype='int64'))
    value = joined['date_diagnosed'].to_numpy(dtype='float64') - joined['date_exposed'].to_numpy(dtype='float64')
    res = pd.DataFrame({'step': step_out, 'run_id': joined['run_id'].to_numpy(), 'agent_id': joined['agent_id'].to_numpy(),
                        'exposure_to_diagnosis_interval': value})
    out = res.set_index(['step', 'run_id', 'agent_id'])[['exposure_to_diagnosis_interval']].sort_index()
    return out

nodes.name: Age-band share of new exposure transitions
nodes.description: Share of a step's new exposure transitions that falls in each age band, the group-level composition of incident infection activity.
nodes.mathematical_definition: p_b(t) = (sum over agents i in band b of X_i(t)) / (sum over all bands of the same sum); undefined when the denominator is 0.
nodes.computation_notes: Age bands are deciles of the empirical age distribution in the run. Shares are defined only at steps with at least one exposure transition.

nodes.name: Layer share of attributed new exposure transitions
nodes.description: Share of a step's layer-attributed exposure transitions that occurs in each contact layer, the setting-level composition of incident activity.
nodes.mathematical_definition: q_l(t) = (sum over agents i of E_i,l(t)) / (sum over all layers of the same sum); undefined when the denominator is 0.
nodes.computation_notes: Only layer-attributed exposures form the denominator; unattributed exposures are excluded from all shares rather than pooled into a residual layer.

nodes.name: Age-band exposure share drift from first active step
nodes.description: Absolute change in an age band's share of exposure transitions between the first step with any exposure transition and the current step.
nodes.mathematical_definition: D_b(t) = |p_b(t) - p_b(t0)|, where t0 is the earliest observed step in the run with at least one exposure transition; undefined when p_b(t) or p_b(t0) is undefined.
nodes.computation_notes: t0 is data-derived and fixed per run, giving a stable reference composition rather than a rolling baseline.

nodes.name: Total-variation drift of age composition of exposures
nodes.description: Total variation distance between the age composition of exposure transitions at the current step and at the first step with any exposure transition.
nodes.mathematical_definition: V_age(t) = 0.5 * sum over bands b of |p_b(t) - p_b(t0)|, with t0 the earliest observed step having at least one exposure transition; undefined when t0 or t is not observed or the step has no exposures.
nodes.computation_notes: Shares over bands are taken as computed at each step without renormalising across missing bands; the 0.5 factor is the total-variation convention.

nodes.name: Total-variation drift of layer composition of attributed exposures
nodes.description: Total variation distance between the layer composition of attributed exposure transitions at the current step and at the first step with any attributed exposure.
nodes.mathematical_definition: V_layer(t) = 0.5 * sum over layers l of |q_l(t) - q_l(t1)|, with t1 the earliest observed step having at least one layer-attributed exposure transition; undefined when either step lacks attributed exposures.
nodes.computation_notes: Complementary to the age-composition drift: it detects shift between settings rather than between age groups, and uses its own data-derived reference step.

nodes.name: Contrast of exposure growth before and after first quarantine onset
nodes.description: Difference between mean per-step logarithmic growth of exposure transitions after the first observed quarantine onset and before it, describing the timing-associated change in the growth regime.
nodes.mathematical_definition: g_before = mean over observed steps s < tq with positive counts n(s-1), n(s) of ln(n(s)/n(s-1)); g_after = the analogous mean over observed steps s > tq; variable = g_after - g_before, where n(t) is the number of exposure transitions at t and tq is the earliest observed step with at least one quarantine transition; undefined if either segment is empty or any needed count is 0.
nodes.computation_notes: tq is derived from the data as the first observed quarantine onset step; the contrast is descriptive of timing and carries no causal claim. Steps with zero counts are excluded because the log ratio is undefined there.

nodes.name: Median age of agents with new exposure transitions
nodes.description: Median age among agents showing a new-exposure transition at a step, tracking the shifting age profile of incident infection activity.
nodes.mathematical_definition: m(t) = median of age_i over agents i observed at step t with X_i(t) = 1; undefined when no agent has a defined exposure transition and age at that step.
nodes.computation_notes: Median over the incident set only, so it moves with cohort composition rather than with the standing population; agents with missing age are excluded from the median.

nodes.name: Agent exposure-step offset from the city infectious trough
nodes.description: Signed distance in sampled steps between an agent's first observed exposure and the step of minimum city-wide infectious prevalence.
nodes.mathematical_definition: o_i = t_i - t*, where t_i is the agent's first observed exposure step and t* is the observed step of minimum count of agents with infectious_i(t) = true within the run (earliest such step on ties); undefined when t_i is undefined or t* is undefined.
nodes.computation_notes: t* is derived from agent-level infectious states, not from a supplied curve, so no external trough time is assumed. Positive values mean exposure after the trough.

nodes.name: Agent exposure transition after the infectious trough
nodes.description: Indicator that an agent's new-exposure transition occurs strictly after the observed city-wide infectious minimum.
nodes.mathematical_definition: R_i(t) = 1 if X_i(t) = 1 and t > t*; 0 if X_i(t) = 1 and t <= t*; undefined if X_i(t) = 0 or t* is undefined.
nodes.computation_notes: t* is the earliest step attaining the minimum of the run's infectious count; the flag is defined only at steps with an actual exposure transition.

nodes.name: Layer attributed-exposure rate ratio after versus at the trough
nodes.description: Ratio of a layer's mean attributed exposure incidence after the infectious trough to its incidence at the trough step.
nodes.mathematical_definition: Phi_l = (mean over observed steps s > t* of lambda_l(s)) / lambda_l(t*), where lambda_l(s) is attributed layer exposure incidence per edge at step s; undefined when lambda_l(t*) = 0, is undefined, or no step after t* is observed.
nodes.computation_notes: The denominator is a single observed step, so it is noisy; the ratio is reported only for layers with a defined non-zero value at t*.

nodes.name: Age-band exposure rate ratio after versus at the trough
nodes.description: Ratio of an age band's mean exposure transition rate after the infectious trough to its rate at the trough step, showing whether resurgence is age-selective.
nodes.mathematical_definition: Psi_b = (mean over observed steps s > t* of h_b(s)) / h_b(t*), with h_b the band exposure hazard per susceptible person-step; undefined when h_b(t*) = 0, is undefined, or no step after t* is observed.
nodes.computation_notes: Uses the same band definition and hazard normalisation as the incidence variables; bands with zero hazard at the trough cannot yield a ratio.

nodes.name: Mean post-trough log growth of infectious agents
nodes.description: Average per-step logarithmic growth of the count of infectious agents over observed steps strictly after the trough.
nodes.mathematical_definition: g = mean over consecutive observed step pairs (s-1, s) with s > t*, I(s-1) > 0 and I(s) > 0 of ln(I(s)/I(s-1)), where I(s) is the count of agents with infectious_i(s) = true; undefined when no such pair exists.
nodes.computation_notes: Consecutive pairs must both be observed; steps with zero infectious counts are excluded because the log ratio is undefined, and the exclusion is reported.

nodes.name: Post-trough rebound amplitude of infectious count
nodes.description: Ratio of the highest infectious-agent count observed after the trough to the count at the trough, the size of the rebound.
nodes.mathematical_definition: A = (max over observed steps s > t* of I(s)) / I(t*); undefined when I(t*) = 0 or no step after t* is observed.
nodes.computation_notes: Both the maximum and the trough value come from the same run's observed steps; there is no smoothing or extrapolation beyond observed steps.

nodes.name: Susceptible share at the infectious trough
nodes.description: Fraction of the observed agent population still susceptible at the trough step, the depletion level against which any rebound occurs.
nodes.mathematical_definition: S(t*) = (number of agents i observed at t* with susceptible_i(t*) = true) / (number of agents observed at t*); undefined when t* is undefined or no agent is observed at t*.
nodes.computation_notes: Uses agent-level susceptible states at the trough step, not the model_states aggregate, so numerator and denominator share one population definition.

nodes.name: Share of layers with post-trough incidence increase
nodes.description: Fraction of contact layers whose attributed exposure incidence is higher on average after the trough than at the trough step, describing how widespread the rebound is.
nodes.mathematical_definition: B = (number of layers l with Phi_l defined and Phi_l > 1) / (number of layers l with Phi_l defined); undefined when no layer has a defined ratio.
nodes.computation_notes: Reuses the per-layer after-versus-at-trough ratio; layers without a defined ratio are excluded from both numerator and denominator rather than counted as non-resurgent.

Population-wide contact volume changes can reflect and reinforce the share of quarantined agents whose degree remains below the non-quarantined median.
A drop in total contact volume is mechanically linked to stronger suppression of quarantined versus non-quarantined contact degree.
Rebound in contact volume after a decline can support post-trough infectious growth by restoring transmission opportunities.
Drift in the age composition of exposures can move the median age of newly exposed agents.
Age-composition shifts can accompany setting-composition shifts when different age groups occupy different contact layers.
Movement of exposure burden across age bands can widen the range between most and least affected band attack ratios.
Sustained positive post-trough infectious growth can raise the maximum infectious count relative to the trough, increasing rebound amplitude.
Broad post-trough growth can appear across multiple contact layers, increasing the share of layers with post-trough incidence increases.
Rapid post-trough growth can overwhelm diagnosis capacity and lower new diagnoses per infectious person-step.
